Change a draft

Related commands:
  draft read
  draft send
  draft create

Output:
  Shows text you can read in your terminal.
  Use --json to get JSON for scripts and other programs.
  Use --jq to filter the JSON output with a jq expression.
  Use --template to format the output with a Go template.

Usage:
  maildo draft update [id] [flags]

Examples:
maildo draft update --id 3c1f2a7 --subject "Updated subject"
maildo draft update --id 3c1f2a7 --account work --body-file draft.html --html
maildo draft update --id 3c1f2a7 --clear-cc --json
maildo draft update --id 3c1f2a7 --body "Preview" --dry-run

Flags:
      --account stringArray    Account to use (default: the active account)
      --bcc stringArray        Bcc recipient; repeat the flag or separate addresses with commas
      --body string            Message body as text
      --body-file string       Read the message body from a file, or from stdin with -
      --cc stringArray         Cc recipient; repeat the flag or separate addresses with commas
      --clear-bcc              Remove all Bcc recipients
      --clear-cc               Remove all Cc recipients
      --clear-reply-to         Remove all Reply-To addresses
      --clear-to               Remove all To recipients
      --from string            Sender, such as "Ann <ann@example.com>"; the address must be the account's own
  -h, --help                   help for update
      --html                   Write the body in HTML; maildo removes unsafe parts
      --id string              Draft id, or the short id maildo printed
      --markdown               Write the body in Markdown; maildo turns it into HTML
      --reply-to stringArray   Reply-To address; repeat the flag or separate addresses with commas
      --subject string         Message subject
      --text                   Write the body as plain text
      --to stringArray         To recipient; repeat the flag or separate addresses with commas

Global Flags:
      --config string     Path to the config file
      --dry-run           Preview changes without performing them
      --include-meta      Wrap the JSON output as {data, meta} with request details
      --jq string         Filter the JSON output with a jq expression
      --json              Output stable JSON instead of the human view
      --no-ansi           Disable all ANSI/control sequences in human output
      --no-color          Disable color in human output
      --no-pager          Never use a pager for long human output
      --no-prompt         Never block on an interactive prompt
      --quiet             Suppress non-essential output
      --template string   Format the JSON output with a Go text/template
